## Summary

**FPU** (Apollo FPU).

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | handles 3 operand float instructions |
| Syntax | `instruction.size <vea>,b,d`<br>where d is the destination |
| Description | Apollo FPU adds some 3 operand instructions to the FPU. B-address mode is allowed. It uses line-F with id=6. The normal FPU instructions use id=1. |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111110` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | b |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7 | R |
| 2 | 6–5 | Size |
| 2 | 4–0 | Opcode |

- B is msb of b. D is msb of d.
- b & d are float-registers. fp0..7 / e0..23
- R = 0 then Mode&Register = 6bit (FPU)vea. Else it is a 5bit float register.
- Size only lsd. 0=long 1=single 2=double 3=reserved

vea: (almost identical to ammx vea):

| A=0 | Mode | Register | A=1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Data register Dn | 000 | Register | Data register E8..15 |
| Data register E0..7 | 001 | Register | Data register E16..23 |
| Address indirect (An) | 010 | Register | (Bn) |
| Address post inc (An)+ | 011 | Register | (Bn)+ |
| Addresss pre decr -(An) | 100 | Register | -(Bn) |
| d16(An) | 101 | Register | d16(Bn) |
| d8(An,Xn.w x Size) | 110 | Register | d8(Bn,Xn.w x Size) |
| d16(pc) | 111 | 010 |  |
| d8(pc,Xn.w x Size) | 111 | 011 |  |
| Abs.w | 111 | 000 |  |
| Abs.l | 111 | 001 |  |
| #imm | 111 | 100 |  |
|  | 111 | 111 |  |

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no FPU. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
